outline:
本課程主要講述化學原理及物質性質之專業知識，下學期部分著重於分析化學、溶液特性與基礎化學理論及觀念之介紹。包括：溶液性質、化學動力學、酸鹼平衡、緩衝溶液、沉澱反應、基礎配位化學、電化學、有機化學以及其應用等。
This course focuses on the principles of chemistry and professional knowledge of material properties. During the second semester, the contents include the introduction of analytical chemistry, solutions, and basic chemical theories and concepts, such as solution properties, chemical kinetics, acid-base equilibrium, buffer solutions, precipitation reactions, coordination chemistry, electrochemistry, organic chemistry and their applications.
schedule:
第1-2週：Thermochemistry
第3-4週：Properties of Solutions
第5-6週：Chemical Equilibrium
第7-8週：Acid and Base
第9-10週：Acid-Base Equilibria
第11-12週：Solubility and Complex Ion Equilibria
第13-14週：Electrochemistry
第15-16週：Chemical Kinetics
第17-18週：Organic Chemistry
assessment:
期中考30-40%
